patches.name: Bypass signature check
patches.description: Bypasses app signature verification to allow API access.

patches.name: Enable all codecs
patches.description: Unlocks H.265, VP9, AV1 and 4K playback on capable devices.

patches.name: Enable screen mirroring
patches.description: Allows playback while screen mirroring or HDMI is connected.

patches.name: Force HDR10
patches.description: Enables HDR10 and HDR10+ playback on compatible devices.

patches.name: Monochrome icon support
patches.description: Adds a themed-icon version of the launcher icon for Android 13+.

patches.name: Premium unlock
patches.description: Unlocks premium UI features, removes subscription nudges, and enables downloads.

patches.name: Remove ChatGPT Voice Assistant
patches.description: Strips out the integrated ChatGPT voice assistant module entirely.

patches.name: Remove ads
patches.description: Removes pre-roll, mid-roll, live-match and home-feed ads.

patches.name: Remove top bar switcher
patches.description: Removes the JioHotstar/Tadka switcher from the top of Home.

patches.name: Anti-delete messages
patches.description: Prevents server-deleted messages from being removed locally.

patches.name: Anti-disappearing media
patches.description: Keeps view-once and self-destructing media viewable forever.

patches.name: Bypass content restrictions
patches.description: Bypasses restricted-content gates and channel no-forward checks.

patches.name: Enable premium
patches.description: Unlocks premium feature UI and shows the premium badge on self only.

patches.name: Hide typing indicator
patches.description: Prevents typing status from being sent to other users.

patches.name: Remove sponsored messages
patches.description: Stops sponsored messages from being fetched and shown in channels.
